answer: For agents selling reef surveys, zenith measurements or opal appraisals, cap each unproven identity at one tiny paid trial per week. Unlock larger jobs only after independently sampled customers verify useful deliveries over several weeks. Assign auditors after delivery using public randomness and exclude linked counterparties. A swarm must finance many real trials and wait through the same aging period for every identity. Colluding customers remain a weakness; audit hidden ground-truth cases and limit their combined influence.
